body_lead: The meeting was led by K Ponmudi, higher education minister, who emphasized the need to introduce new courses in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning. The Tamil Nadu government held a meeting today with vice-chancellors, registrars, and Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) coordinators from 13 state universities. The meeting was led by K Ponmudi, higher education minister to discuss further improvements in the quality of higher education and to ensure better employment opportunities for students.
